sentences.en: Today, as a fifth woman comes forward against Alabama Senate candidate Roy Moore, he doubles down on claims of a Democratic conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 今天，随着第五位女性站出来指控阿拉巴马州参议员候选人罗伊·摩尔，他再次坚称这是一场民主党的阴谋。

sentences.en: And Mitch McConnell says, I believe the women.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔表示：我相信这些女性。

sentences.en: And how YouTube is being used to game the news.
sentences.zh: 以及YouTube是如何被利用来操纵新闻的。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, November 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: I'm here today with a very brave woman from Alabama who alleges that when she was a minor, that she was sexually assaulted by Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 今天我邀请到了一位来自阿拉巴马州的勇敢女性，她声称自己在未成年时曾遭到罗伊·摩尔的性侵。

sentences.en: Cheryl K.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·K·

sentences.en: Stolberg, tell us about this latest allegation against Roy Moore on Monday.
sentences.zh: 斯托尔伯格，请告诉我们周一针对罗伊·摩尔的最新指控。

sentences.en: This latest allegation came from Beverly Young Nelson.
sentences.zh: 这一最新指控来自贝弗利·杨·尼尔森。

sentences.en: She was a 16-year-old girl in the small county where Roy Moore was the district attorney in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 上世纪70年代，罗伊·摩尔担任地区检察官时，她还是那个小县城里一名16岁的女孩。

sentences.en: He was twice her age, and she appeared at the press conference in which she laid out a series of events, what happened between her and Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 当时他比她大一倍，她在新闻发布会上详细讲述了她与罗伊·摩尔之间发生的一系列事件。

sentences.en: When I was 15 years old, I began working after school.
sentences.zh: 我15岁那年开始在课后打工。

sentences.en: She worked in a restaurant as a waitress.
sentences.zh: 她在一家餐馆做服务员。

sentences.en: Mr. Roy Moore was a regular customer.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔先生是那里的常客。

sentences.en: He came in almost every night, and he would stay until closing time.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每晚都来，而且会一直待到打烊。

sentences.en: When he was at the restaurant, she said, he would speak to her, and sometimes he would be flirtatious.
sentences.zh: 她说，当他在餐馆时，会和她搭话，有时还会调情。

sentences.en: I would sometimes pull the ends of my long hair as I walked by him.
sentences.zh: 我走过他身边时，有时会拉扯自己长发的发梢。

sentences.en: I had red hair down to my waiSt. He would compliment me on my look.
sentences.zh: 我当时留着红色的长发，一直垂到腰间。他会称赞我的外表。

sentences.en: Beverly Young Nelson turned 16 in November of that year, 1977, and about a month later, she got her yearbook from the high school where she had spent
sentences.zh: 贝弗利·杨·尼尔森在1977年11月年满16岁，大约一个月后，她拿到了自己在高中度过

sentences.en: her freshman and sophomore years, and she brought it to work with her, and she put it down one night at
sentences.zh: 高一和高二那两年的毕业纪念册，她把它带到了工作场所，有一天晚上她把它放在了

sentences.en: the end of the counter, and she said that Roy Moore happened to notice it, and he asked if he could write in it, and she felt very flattered, and she said yes.
sentences.zh: 柜台尽头，她说罗伊·摩尔碰巧看到了，问能不能在上面写点什么，她感到受宠若惊，于是答应了。

sentences.en: He wrote in my yearbook, as follows,
sentences.zh: 他在我的纪念册上写道：

sentences.en: to a sweeter, more beautiful girl, I could not say Merry Christmas, Christmas 1977, love, Roy Moore,
sentences.zh: 致一位更甜美、更美丽的女孩，我无法表达圣诞快乐，1977年圣诞节，爱你的，罗伊·摩尔，

sentences.en: Old Hickory House, and it signed it Roy Moore DA.
sentences.zh: 老山核桃屋，落款是罗伊·摩尔，地区检察官。

sentences.en: A week or two later, she said, she was working at the restaurant, and her shift ended at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 她说，一两周后，她在餐厅工作，晚上10点下班。

sentences.en: that night when the restaurant closed, and it was cold.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上餐厅打烊了，天气很冷。

sentences.en: And I went outside to wait for my boyfriend to pick me up and drive me home.
sentences.zh: 我走到外面等男朋友来接我回家。

sentences.en: My boyfriend was late, and Mr. Moore exited the restaurant at the same time as I did.
sentences.zh: 我男朋友迟到了，而摩尔先生和我同时走出了餐厅。

sentences.en: And saw that she was waiting and offered to give her a ride home.
sentences.zh: 他看到她在等车，便主动提出开车送她回家。

sentences.en: I trusted Mr. Moore because he was the district attorney.
sentences.zh: 我信任摩尔先生，因为他是地方检察官。

sentences.en: I thought that he was simply doing something nice by offering to drive me home.
sentences.zh: 我以为他主动提出送我回家只是出于好意。

sentences.en: And she said that her house was only about two and a half miles away from the restaurant, and she expected that Roy Moore would just drive her there.
sentences.zh: 她说，她家离餐厅只有两英里半左右，她以为罗伊·摩尔会直接把她送回去。

sentences.en: But instead, he stopped the car and he parked his car in between the dumpster and the back of the restaurant, where there were no lights.
sentences.zh: 但相反，他把车停在了垃圾箱和餐厅后方之间，那里没有灯光。

sentences.en: And while parked, she said, Mr. Moore reached over and began groping me, him putting his hands on my breasts.
sentences.zh: 她说，在停车期间，摩尔先生伸手过来开始猥亵我，把手放在我的胸部上。

sentences.en: I tried to open my car door to leave, but he reached over and he locked it so I could not get out.
sentences.zh: 我试图打开车门离开，但他伸手把车门锁上了，我无法出去。

sentences.en: He also tried, she said, to pull her shirt off.
sentences.zh: 她说，他还试图脱掉她的衬衫。

sentences.en: He began squeezing my neck, attempting to force my head onto his crotch.
sentences.zh: 他开始掐住我的脖子，试图强迫我的头靠向他的胯部。

sentences.en: At a certain point, he gave up.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他放弃了。

sentences.en: He said, you're just a child.
sentences.zh: 他说，你只是个孩子。

sentences.en: And he said, I am the district attorney of Etowoc County.
sentences.zh: 他还说，我是埃托瓦县的地方检察官。

sentences.en: And if you tell anyone about this, no one will ever believe you.
sentences.zh: 如果你把这件事告诉任何人，没人会相信你。

sentences.en: And finally, he allowed her to open the car door and she either fell out or he pushed her out.
sentences.zh: 最后，他允许她打开车门，她要么是摔了出去，要么是被他推了出去。

sentences.en: The day after Mr. Moore assaulted me, I called the restaurant and I quit my job.
sentences.zh: 在摩尔先生袭击我的第二天，我打电话给餐厅辞职了。

sentences.en: I never went back there again.
sentences.zh: 我再也没有回去过。

sentences.en: And she told no one about this until two years later.
sentences.zh: 直到两年后，她才把这件事告诉任何人。

sentences.en: I was scared.
sentences.zh: 我很害怕。

sentences.en: I felt that if I told anyone that Mr. Moore would do something to me or my family.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果我告诉任何人，摩尔先生会对我和我的家人不利。

sentences.en: She told her husband of 13 years before they got married.
sentences.zh: 她在结婚前告诉了她结婚13年的丈夫。

sentences.en: And she said that about four years ago, she told her mother what had happened.
sentences.zh: 她说大约四年前，她把发生的事情告诉了她的母亲。

sentences.en: And I am coming forward today to let Mr. Moore, I want Mr. Moore to know that he no longer has any power over me.
sentences.zh: 我今天站出来是为了让摩尔先生知道，他对我再也没有任何权力了。

sentences.en: And I no longer live in fear of him.
sentences.zh: 我不再生活在对他的恐惧之中。

sentences.en: And so this woman, Beverly Young-Nelson, becomes the fifth woman to allege that
sentences.zh: 所以，这位名叫贝弗利·杨-尼尔森的女性，成为了第五位指控

sentences.en: Roy Moore pursued her sexually, in this case, assaulted her when she was a teenager, right?
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔曾对她进行性骚扰，在这种情况下，是在她十几岁时袭击了她，对吧？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what happened on Monday with Republican senators and Senate leadership like Mitch McConnell?
sentences.zh: 那么周一共和党参议员和像米奇·麦康奈尔这样的参议院领导层发生了什么？

sentences.en: It seemed like a day where people started to draw more definitive lines in the sand around these allegations.
sentences.zh: 看起来那一天人们开始围绕这些指控划出更明确的界限。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's absolutely right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，我认为完全正确。

sentences.en: I actually talked to Mitch McConnell on
sentences.zh: 我实际上在周五和米奇·麦康奈尔谈过。

sentences.en: Friday.
sentences.zh: 周五。

sentences.en: And on Friday, his position was that if the accusations were true, Roy Moore should step aside.
sentences.zh: 周五时，他的立场是如果指控属实，罗伊·摩尔应该退出。

sentences.en: But Monday, Mr. McConnell took a different tack.
sentences.zh: 但周一，麦康奈尔先生采取了不同的策略。

sentences.en: I think he should step aside.
sentences.zh: 我认为他应该退出。

sentences.en: That Roy Moore should leave the race.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔应该退出竞选。

sentences.en: Is the burden on Moore to prove these false versus someone to prove that these are true in this situation?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，是摩尔有责任证明这些指控不实，还是别人有责任证明这些指控属实？

sentences.en: Or do you believe these allegations to be true?
sentences.zh: 或者说，你认为这些指控是真实的吗？

sentences.en: I believe the women, yes.
sentences.zh: 我相信那些女性，是的。

sentences.en: The Republican establishment never supported Roy Moore long before this.
sentences.zh: 共和党建制派早在这次事件之前就从未支持过罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: Roy Moore is a renegade.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔是个叛逆者。

sentences.en: Roy Moore is someone who has made racist and homophobic statements.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔曾发表过种族主义和恐同言论。

sentences.en: He's a former chief justice of
sentences.zh: 他曾担任阿拉巴马州的首席大法官，

sentences.en: Alabama who was twice kicked out of his chief justiceship.
sentences.zh: 但两次被免职。

sentences.en: So he's an incredibly controversial character.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个极具争议的人物。

sentences.en: He is somebody who is not going to follow Mitch McConnell's lead.
sentences.zh: 他绝不会听从米奇·麦康奈尔的指挥。

sentences.en: And yet for Trump Republicans, Moore's become something of a candidate of choice, right?
sentences.zh: 然而对于特朗普派的共和党人来说，摩尔已经成了他们的首选候选人，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: What we're seeing is a real divide between Alabama and Washington Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是阿拉巴马州共和党人和华盛顿共和党人之间真正的分歧。

sentences.en: And the base, the Trump base, the populist base, they love Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 而基层，即特朗普的选民基础、民粹主义基础，他们热爱罗伊·摩尔。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: Mitch McConnell is the new boogeyman for Trump Republicans.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔是特朗普派共和党人心中的新“恶魔”。

sentences.en: They want to get rid of Mitch
sentences.zh: 他们想除掉米奇·

sentences.en: McConnell.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: So anything that Mitch McConnell says carries absolutely no weight with the Trump base of the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 所以米奇·麦康奈尔说的任何话，在共和党的特朗普选民基础中都毫无分量。

sentences.en: And that's Roy Moore's constituency right now.
sentences.zh: 而那正是罗伊·摩尔现在的选民群体。

sentences.en: I want to address what's been brought out on television today.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈今天电视上报道的内容。

sentences.en: So with the Republican establishment now coming out forcefully against Roy Moore and another woman coming forward with very specific allegations, what is Roy Moore saying?
sentences.zh: 那么，随着共和党建制派现在强力反对罗伊·摩尔，又有另一名女性站出来提出非常具体的指控，罗伊·摩尔是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Roy Moore is defiant.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔表现得很强硬。

sentences.en: And I can tell you without hesitation, this is absolutely false.
sentences.zh: 我可以毫不犹豫地告诉你们，这绝对是谎言。

sentences.en: I never did what she said I did.
sentences.zh: 我从未做过她说我做过的事。

sentences.en: I don't even know the woman.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不认识那个女人。

sentences.en: I don't know anything about her.
sentences.zh: 我对她一无所知。

sentences.en: I don't even know where the restaurant is or was.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道那家餐厅在哪里，或者曾经在哪里。

sentences.en: He says he's running and he's certainly not going to let Mitch McConnell stop him.
sentences.zh: 他说他会继续参选，而且绝对不会让米奇·麦康奈尔阻止他。

sentences.en: Because I'm 11 points ahead or 10 or 11 points ahead, this race being just 28 days off, that this is a political maneuver and has nothing to do with reality.
sentences.zh: 因为我领先11个百分点，或者说10到11个百分点，距离选举只剩28天了，这完全是政治操弄，与现实毫无关系。

sentences.en: It's all about politics.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是政治游戏。

sentences.en: And if Moore does not drop out of the race, what does Mitch McConnell see as his options for dealing with that?
sentences.zh: 如果摩尔不退出竞选，米奇·麦康奈尔认为他有哪些应对方案？

sentences.en: They can possibly run a write-in candidate.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会推举一名“写名候选人”。

sentences.en: And Mitch McConnell said today that that was an option that they were considering.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔今天表示，这确实是他们正在考虑的一个选项。

sentences.en: Then, you know, they have to cross the next bridge and see what happens if he gets elected.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，他们必须跨过下一道坎，看看如果他当选了会发生什么。

sentences.en: And then they'll have to figure out, well, do they seat him or do they try to block him from being seated?
sentences.zh: 接着他们得想清楚，是让他就职，还是设法阻止他就职？

sentences.en: And there are procedural ways that you could do that.
sentences.zh: 有一些程序上的方法可以做到这一点。

sentences.en: I think we haven't really gone down that road of exploring those ways just yet.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有真正深入探讨过这些途径。

sentences.en: Or if they don't block him from being seated, do they seat him and then move to expel him?
sentences.zh: 或者，如果他们不阻止他就职，是让他就职后再动议将他驱逐吗？

sentences.en: A senator has not been expelled, I'm told, since the days of the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，自内战时期以来，还没有参议员被驱逐过。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that would obviously be very serious.
sentences.zh: 所以那显然会是非常严重的事情。

sentences.en: Cheryl, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So last Sunday after the Sutherland Springs church shooting, as the news was unfolding,
sentences.zh: 上周日萨瑟兰泉教堂枪击案发生后，随着新闻不断发酵，

sentences.en: I went to YouTube to see what searching for Texas church shooting would bring up.
sentences.zh: 我上了YouTube，想看看搜索“德州教堂枪击案”会出现什么结果。

sentences.en: Kevin Roos covers technology for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯文·罗斯负责《纽约时报》的科技报道。

sentences.en: Maybe five or six of the top 10 videos that came up were not professionally produced news segments.
sentences.zh: 排名前十的视频里，可能有五六个都不是专业制作的新闻片段。

sentences.en: They were just these guys.
sentences.zh: 它们只是这些家伙拍的。

sentences.en: All right, guys, brand new information is coming in.
sentences.zh: 好了伙计们，最新消息传来了。

sentences.en: Some dude in Texas shot up a church in some tiny little town.
sentences.zh: 德州某个小镇的家伙袭击了一座教堂。

sentences.en: It seems clear to me that this guy is a liberal terrorist, if you will, trying to exact revenge on white, conservative American churchgoers.
sentences.zh: 在我看来很清楚，这家伙是个自由派恐怖分子，如果可以这么说的话，他试图向信奉保守主义的美国白人教徒进行报复。

sentences.en: I think it's likely that our government is the one actually perpetrating these terror attacks against the American people.
sentences.zh: 我认为很有可能是我们的政府在对美国人民实施这些恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: I have 100% proof here that he's far leftiSt. Take these images and everything I'm giving you and save them somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我有百分之百的证据证明他是极左分子。把这些图片和我给你们的一切都保存下来。

sentences.en: And if you like this stuff, you know, make sure to like and comment, subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这些内容，记得点赞、评论并订阅。

sentences.en: I do these kind of things all the time.
sentences.zh: 我经常做这类事情。

sentences.en: Kind of amateur shock jock productions where men, usually men, are talking into the camera, giving their theories about what exactly happened.
sentences.zh: 这就像是业余的“惊悚电台”制作，通常是男人们对着镜头说话，发表他们对到底发生了什么的看法。

sentences.en: You said five or six of the top 10.
sentences.zh: 你说排名前十里有五六个是这样的。

sentences.en: So basically half of the content at the top of basically YouTube's charts are from amateur people posting what they think in the moment.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上YouTube榜单前列的一半内容，都是业余人士在当下发表的个人观点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: So these are very far-fetched kind of tabloidy things.

sentences.en: That's changed in recent months.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在最近几个月发生了变化。

sentences.en: As director of law enforcement and information security at Google, I think partly because of the public pressure surrounding the Russia stuff.

sentences.en: that they may have created this machine that has allowed bad actors to take advantage of it.

sentences.en: Things like nudity, hateful content, violent or graphic content, harassment and cyberbullying.

sentences.en: But I think right now they're just overwhelmed.

sentences.en: I have zero respect for the fraud at Ms. NBC.
sentences.zh: 我对 MSNBC 的骗子毫无尊重。

sentences.en: Because if you're so outraged with fake news, you need to actually be outraged with your own damn networks, your own damn papers.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你对假新闻如此愤怒，你需要真正对你自己的该死的新闻网、你自己的该死的报纸感到愤怒。

sentences.en: So I think that there are complaints that this amounts to censoring conservatives or people with unpopular opinions.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有人抱怨这等同于审查保守派或持有不受欢迎观点的人。

sentences.en: This is what they do.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的所作所为。

sentences.en: They're always talking about tolerance, always talking about free speech, always talking about tolerate their BS.
sentences.zh: 他们总是谈论宽容，总是谈论言论自由，总是谈论容忍他们的胡说八道。

sentences.en: But do they ever tolerate us?
sentences.zh: 但他们曾经宽容过我们吗？

sentences.en: Hell to the no.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: That's why I'm not saying that.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我不是在说那个。

sentences.en: Some of the alt-right tech platforms that have emerged in the last few months are supposed to be safe havens for this kind of speech.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月出现的一些另类右翼科技平台本应是这种言论的避风港。

sentences.en: But I think the real sort of big picture implication here is that we've been so focused on Russian interference.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里真正的大局含义是，我们一直太关注俄罗斯的干预了。

sentences.en: There's a much, much bigger problem out there, which is domestic misinformation.
sentences.zh: 外面有一个大得多的问题，那就是国内的虚假信息。

sentences.en: And I think if we just focus on what Russia did last year, we miss out on this much larger information war that is happening all over the Internet.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果我们只关注俄罗斯去年做了什么，我们就会错过互联网上正在发生的这场规模大得多的信息战。

sentences.en: And YouTube is just a tiny part of that.
sentences.zh: 而 YouTube 只是其中的一小部分。

sentences.en: Kevin, thank you.
sentences.zh: 凯文，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Ten days after President Trump said he was frustrated with the Justice Department for not investigating Hillary Clinton and other Democrats,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统表示对司法部没有调查希拉里·克林顿和其他民主党人感到沮丧十天后，

sentences.en: Attorney General Jeff Sessions has asked officials to look into appointing a special counsel to do so.
sentences.zh: 司法部长杰夫·塞申斯（Jeff Sessions）已要求官员考虑任命一名特别检察官来处理此事。

sentences.en: The special counsel would investigate reports of misconduct at the Clinton Foundation and the Obama administration's uranium deal with Russia.
sentences.zh: 特别检察官将调查关于克林顿基金会不当行为以及奥巴马政府与俄罗斯铀交易的报道。

sentences.en: The Times reports that people close to the White House believe that in appointing a special counsel,
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，接近白宫的人士认为，通过任命一名特别检察官，

sentences.en: Sessions might stop the president from firing him, as Trump has hinted he may want to do.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯可能会阻止总统解雇他，正如特朗普所暗示的那样，他可能想这样做。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 以及

sentences.en: On Monday, Iranians searched for survivors of the magnitude 7.3 earthquake that struck near the Iraqi border over the weekend, the world's deadliest earthquake so far this year.
sentences.zh: 周一，伊朗人搜寻了周末在伊拉克边境附近发生的 7.3 级地震的幸存者，这是今年迄今为止世界上最致命的地震。

sentences.en: By Monday evening, Iranian officials said the rescue mission was nearly over, with more than 450 people killed and thousands injured.
sentences.zh: 到周一晚上，伊朗官员表示救援任务已接近尾声，造成超过 450 人死亡，数千人受伤。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbara.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴拉（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter Show》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人在家一样舒适的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为喝醉而昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有任何过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
